newsitem.title: USA: Westamerica to merge with Vallicorp.
newsitem.headline: Westamerica to merge with Vallicorp.

text.p: Westamerica Bancorp said it agreed to merge with ValliCorp Holdings Inc through a stock swap valued at about $304 million.
The deal, based on Westamerica's November 11 price of $52.25 a share, is expected to close in the second quarter.

Under the merger, to be accounted for as a pooling of interests, ValliCorp shareholders would get $21 of value in WestAmerica shares for each Vallicorp share, subject to adjustments, in a tax-free xcahgne of shares.
At September 30, Westamerica had about 9.4 million shares outstanding and ValliCorp had 14.0 million shares outstanding.

ValliCorp parent company of ValliWide Bank, headquartered in Fresno, Calif., has about $1.3 billion in assets and $1.2 billion in deposits and operates 58 offices in 14 counties primarily in the Central Valley of California.
The merger was approved by boards of both companies and is subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.
